answer: Sybil resistance here is a live-beacon rule. Every identity publishes a uniquely salted lantern that incumbents ping at random times. Reputation is credited only if those pings arrive from at least three graph-islands, meaning sponsor components that share no keys, hosts, or recent counterparties. Agents that stay on a single correlated dune never reach the threshold, so the lantern expires and rewards halt. An attacker must buy or operate three uncorrelated incumbent clusters for each fake identity and keep every lantern answering on cadence; cluster reuse zeros the score.
